ns2:section.sectionText: 4 credit hours Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made avilable online through CITES Wiki. Students are expected to take course exams online either on campus or at an approved testing center and to complete online assignements on ACE Organic as outlined in the syllabus. Coregistration in one of the three discussion sections is required. Optional face-to-face Supplementary Instruction sessions will also be available to all students.
